<noinclude><pagequality level="4" user="BRPXQZME" />{{running header|394|{{asc|THE SHIH KING.}}|{{smaller|{{asc|DECADE I.}}}}}}{{rule}}
{{center block/s}}</noinclude><section begin="ode9" />will (of Heaven);{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And thus he secured the confidence due to a king.

He secured the confidence due to a king,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And became the pattern of all below him.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Ever thinking how to be filial,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
His filial mind was the model (which he supplied).

Men loved him, the One man,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And responded (to his example) with a docile virtue.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Ever thinking how to be filial,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
He brilliantly continued the doings (of his fathers).

Brilliantly! and his posterity,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Continuing to walk in the steps of their forefathers,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
For myriads of years,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Will receive the blessing of Heaven.

They will receive the blessing of Heaven,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And from the four quarters (of the kingdom) will felicitations come to them.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
For myriads of years{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Will there not be their helpers?
{{center block/e}}
<section end="ode9" />
<section begin="ode10" />{{dhr}}
{{c|{{sc|Ode 10. The {{tooltip|Wăn Wang yû Shăng|Wén Wáng yǒu Shēng}}.}}}}
{{dhr|0%}}
{{smaller block/s}}
{{hanging indent/s}}
{{asc|The praise of kings [[w:King Wen of Zhou|Wăn]] and [[w:King Wu of Zhou|Wû]]:—how the former displayed his military prowess only to secure the tranquillity of the people; and how the latter, in accordance with the results of divination, entered in his new capital of [[w:Haojing|Hâo]], into the sovereignty of the kingdom with the sincere good will of all the people.}}
{{hanging indent/e}}
{{smaller block/e}}

{{center block/s}}
King {{tooltip|Wăn|Wén}} is famous;{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Yea, he is very famous.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
What he sought was the repose (of the people);{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
What he saw was the completion (of his work).{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
A sovereign true was king Wăn!

King Wăn received the appointment (from Heaven),{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And achieved his martial success.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Having overthrown {{tooltip|''Kh''ung|Chóng}}<ref>As related in [[Sacred Books of the East/Volume 3/The Shih/The Major Odes of the Kingdom/Decade 1/Ode 7|ode 7]].</ref>{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
He fixed his (capital) city in {{tooltip|Făng|Fēng}}<ref name="p394_2">[[w:Fengjing (Zhou)|Făng]] had, probably, been the capital of [[w:zh:崇國|''Kh''ung]], and [[w:King Wen of Zhou|Wăn]]</ref>.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
A sovereign true was king Wăn!
{{nop}}
